0022600034.text: The Pacers (4-8, 1-5 at home, W1 streak) host the Knicks (6-5, 6-4 in their last ten, L1 streak) in a game that is the Pacers' 13th of the season, with Indiana sitting 11th in the East and New York 5th. Indiana is missing Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain, 21.8 points and 33.0 minutes per game this season), Ben Sheppard (knee), and Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), while Aaron Nesmith is day-to-day with knee soreness and is a game-time decision after averaging 11.7 points in 25.2 minutes. The teams have not met yet this season, and the last meeting was a 136-110 Knicks win in New York on March 17, 2026, which followed a 2025-26 season series that Indiana lost 1-3.
